description_en: Initiates batch detection for user-defined skills
description_zh: 批量发起用户自定义Skill检测
name: CreateSkillFileCheck

fields.help_en: The public URL for downloading the file. The downloaded file must be a compressed package in tar.gz or zip format
fields.help_zh: 文件下载的公网URL，下载文件必须为 tar.gz 或 zip 格式的压缩包
fields.name: download_url

fields.help_en: The file name. If not specified, the file name is parsed from DownloadUrl
fields.help_zh: 文件名，如不填写将从DownloadUrl中解析
fields.name: file_name

fields.help_en: The tenant-isolated OSS temporary object key returned by GenerateSkillOssUploadCredential. Specify either this parameter or DownloadUrl
fields.help_zh: GenerateSkillOssUploadCredential返回的租户隔离OSS临时对象Key；与DownloadUrl二选一
fields.name: upload_key

parameters.help_en: The upload source. If left empty, the default value is user_upload. Use sec_ops_agent for the security operations agent
parameters.help_zh: 上传来源；为空默认user_upload，安全运营Agent使用sec_ops_agent
parameters.name: source
